title: Core: Support disabling Checklist widget through feature config
body:
Closes #33279

## What I did

Added `sidebarOnboardingChecklist` feature to support disabling the Checklist sidebar widget through `.storybook/main.ts`:

```js
export default defineMain({
  // ... other config
  features: {
    sidebarOnboardingChecklist: false,
  },
});
```

#### Manual testing

- Restart Storybook and confirm the widget is no longer displayed, and the link to enable/disable it on the Guide page is no longer present.
- Set `sidebarOnboardingChecklist` to `true`, restart Storybook and confirm it's all displayed as normal.

comments.author: Sidnioulz
comments.body:
In what cases can `FEATURES` be undefined? If it is, should we still use the default value of `true` for checklistWidget?

How about
```suggestion
              global.FEATURES?.checklistWidget !== false && <ChecklistWidget />}
```

comments.author: ghengeveld
comments.body: I think it's just the TS type that's optional, in practice it's always set except in tests/stories. Good improvement nonetheless 👍

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests a specific code change using optional chaining to handle potentially undefined FEATURES, with a concrete code suggestion.
Provides a concrete code suggestion to apply the same optional chaining pattern in a second file.

comments.author: Sidnioulz
comments.body:
Could be worth circling back with MA or Kyle on the naming. My assumption is users would search for something "onboarding" related in the docs, so having `onboarding` in the name might help discoverability.

I lean towards `onboardingChecklist` but haven't given this much thought so feel free to discard this opinion unashamedly!

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests renaming the feature flag to something more discoverable (e.g., 'onboardingChecklist'), implying a naming change should be considered.

comments.author: ndelangen
comments.body:
```suggestion
    onboardingInSidebar?: boolean;
```

I propose we link the featureFlag specifically to the sidebar, since that's what we're disabling.

I personally think the word "widget" has no meaning in storybook at the moment, so I'd prefer we avoided the word.

I agree with @Sidnioulz that `checklist` is a technical term, for the feature, and `onboarding` is more user-facing.

comments.author: ghengeveld
comments.body: I would go with `sidebarOnboardingChecklist` in that case. Technically onboarding is something else, but I understand why people would look for that terminology.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Proposes a specific rename of the feature flag to 'onboardingInSidebar' with reasoning, including a concrete code suggestion block.
